notes.description: 104 blocks. Nine sections with ten paragraphs each. Boundaries are after paragraph 5 and paragraph 10 of each section, plus one boundary after the introduction. This creates mid-section transitions while keeping headings as segment anchors.
notes.heading_split_would_be: gaps after each section's last paragraph (end of section)
notes.design_intent: Paragraphs reuse shared vocabulary (pipeline, latency, throughput, backpressure) so boundaries rely on topic shifts rather than keyword changes.
notes.raw_comparison: embedder 比較（raw）時は --profile embedder --split-count 19 を推奨。split-count を gold params に入れると final 評価で section lock との干渉が起きるため手動指定とする。
